bounded_callsite_comparison.interpretation: Both caller windows call the version-specific helper at the same +0xb67 offset from their respective function entries. The register/immediate window and direct 32-byte RM_CONTROL ABI are structurally aligned; `.178` runtime correlation is not runtime evidence for `.196`.

limits: No R580.196.07 runtime ioctl, command value, parameter payload, RM status, or returned feature mask was observed.
The static callsite proves only generic direct RM_CONTROL packet construction and does not identify SYSTEM_GET_FEATURES on .196.
No module, GPU, VM, PCI binding, or driver state was changed.
Generated Ghidra labels and nearest-export annotations are not vendor source names.

r580_196_packet_construction.helper_syscall_dataflow: The helper copies RCX to R12 and R8 to RBX, then calls ioctl(fd=RDI, request=RCX, argument=R8). The caller therefore passes the stack NVOS54 packet to the direct RM_CONTROL ioctl.
r580_196_packet_construction.nested_parameters: NVOS54.params points to the function input RCX; its target and the parameter payload are not decoded.
r580_196_packet_construction.nested_rm_command: NVOS54.cmd is copied from the function input EDX; this bounded static slice does not establish that value as 0x1f0.

runtime_anchor.scope: On the separate .178 stock V100 path, feature sensitivity runtime chain and root-query capture establish a .178 reference. The .196 packet command and params remain dynamic/opaque.
